title: Automated tests

spans.text: Tests encode expected behavior and check it after changes. unittest is in the standard library; each test should cover a behavior and clean up temporary files.

spans.code: The test runner reports one test passed; exact summary depends on the runner.

spans.text: A test compares the expected result with the actual result.

spans.title: Important tip
spans.text: Test boundary cases and empty inputs, not only the happy path.

visual_description: A separate visual is not essential; a small runnable code example and its expected output explain the topic.
